conviction_note: Two-sided name. The Q3 EPS bar ($0.03, Earnings Whispers) sits below Q2's $0.09, and management said in July that earnings would 'gradually improve', so a beat on the quarter is plausible. Against that, European gas (TTF) rose about 69% between June 1 and mid-September, after O-I said in Q1 that its favourable European energy contracts had expired. That raises the risk of a fourth consecutive guidance cut, and the last two cuts cost -15% each. Short interest is 11.5% of shares outstanding and rising, a squeeze mechanism, but the stock has already run up 13% in 20 days. impact_sum (+1.0) and the scaled number (-0.56, p_up 48 x abs 14) differ in sign. The reason is that the findings sum pays the squeeze and the low bar on their own, while p_up gives weight to the +9.9 put skew and to the guidance line, which is the line this stock has traded on in each of the last three prints.
bar: Q3 2026 adjusted EPS consensus $0.03 and revenue $1.52B per Earnings Whispers (https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/oi, fetched 2026-10-27). Benzinga snapshots disagree at ~$1.62-1.63B revenue (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/OI/earnings-forecasts), so the revenue bar is disputed and EPS has a single source, and every finding is capped small. The company guide is FY2026 adjusted EBITDA $1.0-1.1B, FCF a use of $50-150M, leverage at or slightly above 4x, and no EPS guide (withdrawn because of the 40-70% tax rate). Source: 8-K ex99.1 of 2026-07-28, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000812074/000110465926087559/tm2621494d1_ex99-1.htm. H1 2026 adj EPS was $0.14 and H1 segment operating profit $313M (Americas $307M, Europe $6M).
positioning_check: Short interest (FINRA, via equibles) was 17,616,146 shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, about 11.5% of the 153.66M shares outstanding, with days to cover 4.97. That is up from 15.69M on 09-30 and has nearly doubled from 9.34M on 2026-06-30 (https://equibles.com/stocks/oi/shortinterest). Skew_25d is +9.93 vol points, so downside is paid. Put/call OI is 0.83. The ATM spread is 62% of mid, so the 13.39% implied move is indicative only. Run-up is +7.95% over 5 days and +13.12% over 20, but the stock is still 61.6% below its 52-week high. Post-Q2 drift was -28.5% to the October low. Into the print UBS downgraded to Neutral with a $6 target (Oct 5), RBC cut to $7 (Oct 13) and Wells Fargo cut to $10 (Oct 19). Citi has carried an upside 90-day catalyst watch since Aug 21.

findings.finding: Dutch TTF gas rose from EUR 47.83/MWh on 2026-06-01 to EUR 80.77 on 2026-09-11 (+69%), and the November contract was still EUR 76.14 on 2026-10-02. In its Q1 2026 report O-I said Europe's energy costs had stepped up after favourable contracts expired, so Q3 Europe (segment profit $0 in Q1, $6M in Q2) carries a higher energy bill than the July 28 guide may have assumed. That raises the risk of a fourth consecutive cut to the FY2026 $1.0-1.1B EBITDA guide or to the 2027 $1.2-1.3B target.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance cuts drove the last two prints: Q1 2026 cut on European energy costs, -15.53%; Q2 2026 EBITDA guide cut and 2027 target lowered, -15.01%. Q3 2025 (Europe profit +70%) was +14.15%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The +9.9 put skew and the October target cuts (UBS $6, RBC $7) lean the same way. If it were fully priced, the stock would not have rallied +13% over 20 days into the print, and the consensus FY EPS of ~$0.36 on MarketBeat would have been cut. How much of the Q3 spike is hedged is not public, so the size of the hit to the guide is unknown to the market as well.
findings.independence: Company-level confirmation of energy exposure: Q1 2026 release said Europe segment profit fell on 'a step-up in energy costs following expiration of favorable contracts' (https://app.edgar.tools/filing/812074/0001104659-26-050406/tm2612892d1_ex99-1.htm, 2026-04-28). TTF level corroborated by ANSA/soldionline on 2026-10-02 (https://www.soldionline.it/notizie/forex-commodities/gas-perche-e-tornato-sopra-76-euro-il-future-ttf-novembre-298). Macro-to-company transmission is a proxy, because the hedge ratio is not disclosed.

findings.finding: The Q3 adjusted EPS bar of $0.03 (Earnings Whispers) is below Q2's $0.09 and below the H1 run-rate of $0.07 per quarter. In the July 28 release management said adjusted earnings would 'gradually improve over the rest of 2026'. The Americas furnace event was 'substantially resolved in July', $115-120M of Fit to Win savings is expected in H2 (just under half locked in), and new business adds 1-1.5% to volume. If the quarter merely follows the company's own trajectory, it clears the bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 beat with Europe profit +70% bought +14.15%. Q2 2026 EPS miss ($0.09 vs $0.22-0.24) with a guide cut sold -15.01%. Q1 2026 miss ($0.05 vs $0.09) with a cut sold -15.53%. The stock has traded the guide, not the EPS print, on the last two quarters.
findings.why_not_priced: Analysts appear to have modelled Q3 below Q2 despite the company saying the opposite. The October target cuts (UBS, RBC, Wells) reset expectations lower. If the market believed the company's trajectory, consensus would sit at or above $0.09. The bar has a single source (Benzinga snapshots disagree), and the 40-70% tax rate makes EPS noisy, so the size is capped.
findings.independence: Company trajectory statements come from the Q2 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000812074/000110465926087559/tm2621494d1_ex99-1.htm) and the Q2 call (https://earningswhispers.com/transcript/OI/Q22026). These are the same document family as the guide, a different source from the bar. Finding 1 cuts against it on the Europe energy line.

findings.finding: Short interest rose from 9.34M shares (2026-06-30) to 17.62M (2026-10-15), about 11.5% of shares outstanding with 4.97 days to cover. On an equity worth about $1B against about $4.6B of net debt, any 'less bad' print can force covering.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (Nov 2025, short interest ~9M) rose +14.15% on an improvement print. The Aug 21 Citi upgrade moved the stock +11.9% intraday, which shows how much the price responds to a positive catalyst.
findings.why_not_priced: The short build continued through Oct 15. Part of the +13% 20-day run-up (including the low-volume +8.7% on Oct 22) may already be covering, which is why the size is modest. If the squeeze were spent, short interest would have fallen into the print, and the latest settlement shows it rising.
findings.independence: The run-up in the baseline (+7.95% over 5 days) and the low-volume +8.7% day on 2026-10-22 (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/price-o-i-glass-nyse-oi-shares-climb-87-whats-next-2026-10-22/) are consistent with covering. Not independent of each other.

findings.finding: European beverage-can makers reported strong Q3 2026 volumes after O-I last spoke. Ardagh Metal Packaging Europe +6% (2026-10-22). Crown European beverage +4%, continental Europe +7%. European beverage consumption held up in Q3. Cans also compete with glass for beer share, so the read-across to O-I's European glass volumes (Q2 -2%) is ambiguous.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior O-I reaction attributable to can-peer read-across. OI rose +8.7% on 2026-10-22, the day AMBP reported.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced: the stock moved on the day. It is filed because it postdates O-I's last statement. The open question is whether glass volumes followed the drinks demand or lost share to cans.
findings.independence: Crown Q3 2026 (https://www.packagingdive.com/news/crown-holdings-q3-2026-packaging-earnings/833557/), a different company with the same direction. A proxy: neither is a glass producer.

findings.finding: Constellation Brands (Mexican-import beer, a large US glass beer-bottle user) reported fiscal Q2 2027 (Jun-Aug 2026) beer shipments +5.5% with depletions -0.6% on 2026-10-07. Management called September 'a broad-based recovery'. This points to stable to slightly better Americas beer glass demand in Q3 than O-I's Q2 Americas volume of -7%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Americas has been the bright spot (Q2 segment profit +22%), but the stock has traded Europe and the guide.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a customer read-through that sell-side glass previews rarely carry. It is small because O-I's share of Constellation's glass supply is not confirmed here, and Americas volume declines partly reflect O-I's deliberate exits from unprofitable business.
findings.independence: None from a different source. A proxy, and the supplier relationship is not confirmed in a document.

findings.finding: Citi upgraded OI to Buy ($8 to $9 target) on 2026-08-21 and placed an upside 90-day catalyst watch, which runs through about 2026-11-19 and so covers this print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose about 11.9% intraday on the upgrade day.
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced: it is a public opinion two months old, and the stock has since fallen back below the upgrade-day level. It is filed because the catalyst watch is dated to this window.
findings.independence: The UBS downgrade to a $6 target (2026-10-05) points the other way (https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/nebenwerte/ubs-cuts-o-i-glass-stock-target-to-usd-6-00/70351312).

searched_and_found_nothing: EDGAR since 2026-07-01: only the Q2 8-K/10-Q, the 07-10 Item 5.02 (Europe SVP exit, pre-Q2), a director phantom-stock Form 4 (10-01) and passive 13G/As (Dimensional 4.3%, Cooper Creek 5.5%). No financing, no Form 144, no insider selling.
No pre-announcement, no new financing and no rating action found since the July 28 print. Liquidity $1.5B, no maturities until 2028.
Verallia Q3 2026 is released the same evening (2026-10-27 after close), so its content was unknown at seal. Vidrala and Heineken Q3 2026 updates not found published before the seal.
No October 2026 strategic-option (Horizon 3 portfolio) announcement found.

baseline_tension: Finding 1 (energy, guide risk) agrees with the +9.9 put skew. The low bar and the crowded short cut against the skew but agree with the +13% run-up. Net the evidence is close to balanced, which is why p_up is 48 rather than further from 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar has one source / disputed revenue bar): low-bar finding capped from +2.0 to +1.0. The finding also lands inside the company's own guided trajectory.
Rules 5 and 7 (macro proxy that agrees with the put skew, on a name with a rising 11.5% short): energy finding cut from -2.0 to -1.5. Kept because a company document confirms the exposure.
Rule 5 (proxies): can-peer read-across +0.3 to +0.2, Constellation read-through +0.3 to +0.2, Citi catalyst watch +0.2 to +0.1.
Rule 1 (the reaction runs on the guide, not the EPS print): p_up moved from 47 to 48 and print_vs_bar from +2.0 to +1.5. abs_move left at 14.
